tool_args.rationale: The paid rows show diminishing gains with input and lower output at higher gradients. A saturating baseline plus a gradient-suppressed saturating component gives training RMSE of about 0.0017 and leave-one-out RMSE of about 0.0035. That supports submitting the model for fresh confirmation at H = 0.6 without another probe; dependence on horizon and initial state remains untested.

considered_alternatives.option: Single saturating response with hyperbolic gradient suppression
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its training RMSE was about 0.060, above the 0.045 tolerance.
Both probes still measured endpoints at the same horizon and initial state. The data support an endpoint law but do not identify separate time constants.
It does not test either the input saturation or the gradient suppression.
